## What happened

Change notice CHG-0140 records the introduction of SMS reminder three days before appointment. The change started on 2023-01-09 and applies to the appointment reminder process. This notice provides a formal record of the change and its implementation.

## Cause

The cause was Service improvement, rolled out everywhere at once. The change was introduced as part of service improvement activity and implemented across all areas at the same time.

## Effect

The expected effect is Attendance changes by district. Attendance information may therefore vary between districts following the introduction of the reminder. Services should take this change into account when reviewing attendance patterns and related data.

Questions about this notice should be directed to the service desk, quoting CHG-0140.
